description: Calculate take-home pay from a UK salary for a tax year: income tax by band (England, Wales and Northern Ireland, or Scotland), employee National Insurance, student loan repayment and pension contributions, with yearly, monthly and weekly take-home and the employer National Insurance and total cost to the employer.

pensionContributions.description: Employee pension contributions a year, in pounds

scottishTaxpayer.description: True for a Scottish taxpayer (Scottish bands)

studentLoanPlan.description: Student loan plans held: one plan or a list of every plan, e.g. ["plan2", "postgrad"]. plan1 (pre-2012), plan2 (2012 onwards), plan4 (Scotland), plan5 (2023 onwards), postgrad (postgraduate loan, repaid alongside any other plan). Omit or "none" for no loan.

taxYear.description: UK tax year, e.g. "2026-27". Defaults to the current one.

name: calculate_take_home_pay
title: Calculate take-home pay
